senses: light, brightness, usually with genitive of something that shines or reflects: of the moon, [[r:MAT.24.29|Mat 24:29]], [[r:MRK.13.24|Mrk 13:24]]; of a lamp, [[r:LUK.11.33|Luk 11:33]] (WH, RV, φῶς).† SYN.: αὐγή, q.v (AS)

G5355.root: probably akin to the base of [[w:G5351]]
senses: envy: [[r:ROM.1.29|Rom 1:29]], [[r:GAL.5.21|Gal 5:21]], [[r:1TI.6.4|1Ti 6:4]], [[r:TIT.3.3|Tit 3:3]], [[r:1PE.2.1|1Pe 2:1]]; διὰ φθόνον, [[r:MAT.27.18|Mat 27:18]], [[r:MRK.15.10|Mrk 15:10]], [[r:PHP.1.15|Php 1:15]]; πρὸς φθόνον ἐπιποθεῖ τ. πνεῦμα (on the meaning, see R, txt., mg. 1, 2; Hort, Ja., 93 f.), [[r:JAS.4.5|Jas 4:5.]]† (AS)
(ὑστερέω), need, want: opposite to τὸ περισσεῦον, [[r:MRK.12.44|Mrk 12:44]]; καθ᾽ ὑ., [[r:PHP.4.11|Php 4:11]] (eccl.).† (AS)

G5311.strongs: elevation, i.e. (abstractly) altitude, (specially), the sky, or (figuratively) dignity
senses: height: [[r:EPH.3.18|Eph 3:18]] [[r:JAS.1.9|Jas 1:9]], [[r:REV.21.16|Rev 21:16]]; of heaven (EV, on high), ἐξ ὕ., [[r:LUK.1.78|Luk 1:78 24:49]]; εἰς ὕ., [[r:EPH.4.8|Eph 4:8]] (LXX)† (AS)

G5327.root: properly, strengthened from the base of [[w:G4008]] or rather of [[w:G4486]]
G5327.strongs: a gap or chasm, i.e. ravine (winter-torrent)

G5317.forms: Φάλεκ (T, Rec. Φαλέκ, L, mg., Φάλεγ), ὁ indecl. (Heb. D, Ge 1116)

senses: (φιλέω), a kiss: [[r:LUK.7.45|Luk 7:45 22:48]]; as a token of Christian brotherhood, φ. ἅγιον, [[r:ROM.16.16|Rom 16:16]], [[r:1CO.16.20|1Co 16:20]], [[r:2CO.13.12|2Co 13:12]], [[r:1TH.5.26|1Th 5:26]]; φ. ἀγάπης, [[r:1PE.5.14|1Pe 5:14]] (see Lft., Notes, 90; DB, DCA, see word "Kiss").† (AS)

G5303.kjv: that which is behind, (that which was) lack(-ing), penury, want
senses: that which is lacking, deficiency, shortcoming: with genitive puss. (prop. pose.), [[r:1CO.16.17|1Co 16:17]], [[r:PHP.2.30|Php 2:30]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:COL.1.24|Col 1:24]], [[r:1TH.3.10|1Th 3:10]];

need, want, poverty ([[r:PSA.34.10|Psa 34:10]], [[r:JDG.18.10|Jdg 18:10]], al.): [[r:LUK.21.4|Luk 21:4]], [[r:2CO.9.12|2Co 9:12 11:9]]; opposite to περίσσευμα, [[r:2CO.8.13|2Co 8:13-14]] (eccl.).† (AS)
(φιλόνεικος), love of strife, rivalry, emulation (Plat., al.), but mostly in bad sense (Thuc., al.), contentiousness, contention: [[r:LUK.22.24|Luk 22:24]] (but see Field, Notes, 75 f.).† (AS)

slight, worthless, of no account, both of persons and things in various shades of meaning (see LS, see word), in NT, as frequently in cl., always with distinct moral reference (see Ellic., Past. Epp., 203; Hort, Ja., 85; Tr., Syn., LXXxiv), worthless, bad: [[r:JHN.3.20|Jhn 3:20]], [[r:TIT.2.8|Tit 2:8]], [[r:JAS.3.16|Jas 3:16]]; opposite to ἀγαθός (which see), [[r:JHN.5.29|Jhn 5:29]], [[r:ROM.9.11|Rom 9:11]], [[r:2CO.5.10|2Co 5:10]].† SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος (AS)
(φαίνω), a torch or lantern (see Rutherford, NPhr., 131 f.): [[r:JHN.18.3|Jhn 18:3.]]† SYN.: see: λαμπάς (AS)

hyssop, of which a bunch was used in ritual sprinklings: [[r:HEB.9.19|Heb 9:19]]; of a branch or rod (?) of hyssop, [[r:JHN.19.29|Jhn 19:29]] (but see Field, Notes, 106 ff., for suggestion to substitute ὑσσῷ here).† (AS)

G5350.root: probably akin to [[w:G5338]] and thus to [[w:G5346]]
G5350.strongs: to utter a clear sound, i.e. (generally) to proclaim
senses: φθέγγομαι of men or animals, to utter a sound or voice: absol., [[r:ACT.4.18|Act 4:18]]; before ἐν φωνῇ, [[r:2PE.2.16|2Pe 2:16]]; with accusative, ὑπέρογκα, [[r:2PE.2.18|2Pe 2:18.]]† (AS)

(in FlJ, Ant., viii, 6, 2, Φαραών, -ῶνος), (Heb. פַּרְעֹה), Pharaoh, the general title of the kings of Egypt: [[r:ACT.7.13|Act 7:13, 21]], [[r:ROM.9.17|Rom 9:17]], [[r:HEB.11.24|Heb 11:24]]; Φ. βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου, [[r:ACT.7.10|Act 7:10.]]† (AS)

G5386.strongs: fond of wise things, i.e. a "philosopher"

G5339.strongs: to be chary of, i.e. (subjectively) to abstain or (objectively) to treat leniently

G5334.root: from [[w:G5346]] (not the same as "phase", which is from [[w:G5316]])
senses: (φαίνω), information, esp. against fraud or other crime: [[r:ACT.21.31|Act 21:31.]]† (AS)
φάσκω to affirm, assert: with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.24.9|Act 24:9 25:19]]; with inf. and nom., [[r:ROM.1.22|Rom 1:22.]]† (AS)
φῆστος, -ου, ὁ (Porcius), Festus, procurator of Judæa: [[r:ACT.24.27|Act 24:27 25:1]] ff. [[r:ACT.26.24|Act 26:24-25, 32]].† (AS)

G5364.root: adverb from a compound of [[w:G5384]] and [[w:G0444]]

senses: (φιλάνθρωπος, humane), humanity, kindness (see Field, Notes, 147 f.): [[r:ACT.28.2|Act 28:2]], [[r:TIT.3.4|Tit 3:4]] (cf. also DCG, ii, 356 ff.).† (AS)

G5390.strongs: with friendliness of mind, i.e. kindly

senses: perishable, corruptible: ἄνθρωπος, [[r:ROM.1.23|Rom 1:23]] (opposite to ἄφθαρτος θεός); στέφανος, [[r:1CO.9.25|1Co 9:25]] (opposite to αρτος); σπσρά, [[r:1PE.1.23|1Pe 1:23]] (opposite to ἄφθ.); neut., τὸ φ. τοῦτο, [[r:1CO.15.53|1Co 15:53-54]]; pl., [[r:1PE.1.18|1Pe 1:18.]]† (AS)

G5356.strongs: decay, i.e. ruin (spontaneous or inflicted, literally or figuratively)
senses: (φθείρω) destruction, corruption, decay (see Mayor on 2Pe, App.,175 ff.): [[r:ROM.8.21|Rom 8:21]], [[r:1CO.15.42|1Co 15:42]], [[r:COL.2.22|Col 2:22]], [[r:2PE.2.12|2Pe 2:12]]; opposite to ζωὴ αἰώνιος, [[r:GAL.6.8|Gal 6:8]]; by meton., of that which is subject to corruption, [[r:1CO.15.50|1Co 15:50]]; of moral decay, [[r:2PE.1.4|2Pe 1:4 2:12 2:19]] (cf. [[r:WIS.14.12|Wis 14:12]]).† (AS)

G5313.strongs: an elevated place or thing, i.e. (abstractly) altitude, or (by implication) a barrier (figuratively)
senses: that which is lifted up, a barrier: [[r:2CO.10.5|2Co 10:5.]]† (AS)

G5353.strongs: utterance, i.e. a musical note (vocal or instrumental)

G5360.kjv: brotherly love (kindness), love of the brethren
senses: (φιλάδελφος), the love of brothers, brotherly love: of Christians' mutual love as brethren (see: ἀδελφός), [[r:ROM.12.10|Rom 12:10]], [[r:1TH.4.9|1Th 4:9]], [[r:HEB.13.1|Heb 13:1]], [[r:1PE.1.22|1Pe 1:22]], [[r:2PE.1.7|2Pe 1:7]].† (AS)

G5387.root: from [[w:G5384]] and στοργή (cherishing one's kindred, especially parents or children)
G5387.strongs: fond of natural relatives, i.e. fraternal towards fellow Christian
senses: (στοργή, family affection), tenderly loving, affectionate (Xen., Plut., al.): of Christians, [[r:ROM.12.10|Rom 12:10.]]† (AS)

G5389.root: middle voice from a compound of [[w:G5384]] and [[w:G5092]]
G5389.strongs: to be fond of honor, i.e. emulous (eager or earnest to do something)
senses: (φίλος, τιμή), to love or seek after honour, hence, to be ambitious, emulous (Plat., Plut., al.): with inf., [[r:ROM.15.20|Rom 15:20]], [[r:2CO.5.9|2Co 5:9]], [[r:1TH.4.11|1Th 4:11]].† (AS)

G5393.root: active participle of the base of [[w:G5395]]

G5378.strongs: fond of words, i.e. talkative (argumentative, learned, "philological"); Philologus, a Christian
senses: 1. fond of speaking , (Plato Philosophus) 2. fond of learning, literary , Lat. studiosus, (Aristotle Philosopher) (ML)

G5351.root: probably strengthened from φθίω (to pine or waste)
G5351.strongs: properly, to shrivel or wither, i.e. to spoil (by any process) or (generally) to ruin (especially figuratively, by moral influences, to deprave)
senses: φθείρω to destroy, corrupt, spoil (on the varied usage and distinctive meaning of the word, see Mayor on 2Pe, App., 175 ff.): with accusative, [[r:1CO.3.17|1Co 3:17 15:23]], [[r:2CO.7.2|2Co 7:2]]; before ἀπό, [[r:2CO.11.3|2Co 11:3]]; ἐν, [[r:2PE.2.12|2Pe 2:12]], Ju 10, [[r:REV.19.2|Rev 19:2]]; κατά, [[r:EPH.4.22|Eph 4:22]] (cf. δια-, κατα-φθείρω).† (AS)

G5380.strongs: probably akin to); fond of strife, i.e. disputatious

G5321.strongs: exhibition, i.e. (figuratively) expression, (by extension) a bestowment

G5331.strongs: medication ("pharmacy"), i.e. (by extension) magic (literally or figuratively)
senses: φαρμακία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ (φαρμακεύω, to administer drugs) poët. and late prose form of φαρμακεία,
generally, the use of medicine, drugs or spells (Xen.).
sorcery, witchcraft: [[r:GAL.5.20|Gal 5:20]] (see Lft., in l), [[r:REV.9.21|Rev 9:21]] (WH, txt., φαρμάκων) [[r:REV.18.23|Rev 18:23]] (cf. LXX, ll. with).† (AS)
(φθόνος), to envy: with dative (L, txt., Tr., mg., WH, mg., accusative), as in cl., [[r:GAL.5.26|Gal 5:26.]]† (AS)

G5374.strongs: a Philippesian (Philippian), i.e. native of Philippi
senses: φιλιππήσιος, -ου, ὁ (for other forms in use, see Lft., in l) a Philippian: [[r:PHP.4.15|Php 4:15.]]† (AS)

Φιλο-σοφία, -ας, ἡ (φιλόσοφος), the love and pursuit of wisdom; hence, philosophy, investi­gation of truth and nature: of the so-called philosophy of false teachers, [[r:COL.2.8|Col 2:8]] (see Lft., ICC, in l).† (AS)

G5306.root: comparative from [[w:G5259]] (in the sense of behind)
senses: latter, later: ἐν ὑ. καιροῖς, [[r:1TI.4.1|1Ti 4:1]] (on the reading ὁ ὕ., WH, for ὁ πρῶτος, see WH, App., in l). Neut., τὸ ὕ., used adverbially instead of ὑστέρως, afterwards, later: [[r:MAT.4.2|Mat 4:2 21:29, 32 21:37 25:11 26:60]], [[r:MRK.16.14|Mrk 16:14]], [[r:LUK.20.32|Luk 20:32]], [[r:JHN.13.36|Jhn 13:36]], [[r:HEB.12.11|Heb 12:11]]; with genitive, [[r:MAT.22.27|Mat 22:27.]]† (AS)
(φλύω, to babble), babbling, garrulous: [[r:1TI.5.13|1Ti 5:13]] (EV, tattlers; of things, φιλοσοφία, 4Mac, l.with).† (AS)
(φιλάργυρος), love of money, avarice: [[r:1TI.6.1|1Ti 6:1.]]† SYN.: πλεονεξία, covetousness (see Tr., Syn., § xxiv) (AS)

G5309.strongs: to be lofty in mind, i.e. arrogant
senses: ὑψηλο- φρονέω, -ῶ = μευαλοφρονεῖν (Xen., Plat., al.), to be high-minded: [[r:1TI.6.17|1Ti 6:17]] (WH, mg., ὑψηλὰ, φρονεῖν).† (AS)

G5372.strongs: amiable; Philetus, an opposer of Christianity

senses: φίλ-αυτος, -ον loving oneself (Arist.); in bad sense (ib.), selfish: [[r:2TI.3.2|2Ti 3:2.]]† SYN.: αὐθάδης (see Tr., Syn., § xciii) (AS)

G5341.root: by transposition for a derivative probably of [[w:G5316]] (as showing outside the other garments)
senses: φελόνης (Rec. φαιλ-), -ου, ὁ by metath. for παινόλης (also φενόλης, φαινόλιον; Lat. pænula) a cloak (see DCG, i, 338; on the idea that the meaning here is book-cover, see CGT, in l; Milligan, NTD, 20; Field, Notes, 217 f., where the view that the φ. here is an eccl. vestment is discussed): [[r:2TI.4.13|2Ti 4:13.]]† (AS)

G5358.strongs: fond to good, i.e. a promoter of virtue
senses: φιλ-άγαθος, -ον loving that which is good, loving goodness: [[r:TIT.1.8|Tit 1:8]] (Arist., Polyb., a l.).† (AS)

G5362.strongs: fond of man, i.e. affectionate as a wife
senses: Of a wife, loving her husband (frequently in epitaphs, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 255): [[r:TIT.2.4|Tit 2:4.]]† (AS)

G5388.strongs: fond of one's children, i.e. maternal
senses: (φίλος, τέκνον), loving one's children (Hdt., Arist., Plut., al.): of women, joined with φίλανδρος, which see, [[r:TIT.2.4|Tit 2:4.]]† (AS)
Pass., = δειλός, feeling fear, timid (cl. in both senses).† (AS)

G5324.strongs: to make apparent, i.e. (passively) to appear (neuter participle as noun, a spectacle)
senses: (φαίνω) to make visible. In cl. used in pass. only, = φαίνομαι, to become visible, appear: ptcp., [[r:HEB.12.21|Heb 12:21.]]† (AS)

G5394.strongs: to cause a blaze, i.e. ignite (figuratively, to inflame with passion)
senses: (φλόξ), to set on fire, burn, burn up: figuratively, [[r:JAS.3.6|Jas 3:6]] (on the meaning of the sentence, see Hort, in l).† (AS)
φιλ-άδελφος, -ον loving one's brother, loving like a brother (Soph., Xen., al.): of Christians' love for one another (EV, loving as brethren), [[r:1PE.3.8|1Pe 3:8.]]† (AS)

G5383.strongs: to be fond of being first, i.e. ambitious of distinction
senses: φιλο-πρωτιύω (φιλόπρωτος, Plut., al.) to strive to be first: III Jn 9 (eccl.).† (AS)

G5396.strongs: to be a babbler or trifler, i.e. (by implication) to berate idly or mischievously
senses: (φλύαρος), to talk nonsense: with accusative of person(s), ἡμᾶς (EV, prating against us), III Jn 10.† (AS)

G5352.strongs: akin to the base of) and (meaning late autumn); autumnal (as stripped of leaves)
senses: φθιν-οπωρινός, -ή, -όν (φθινόπωρον, late autumn), autumnal: δένδρα φ., autumn trees (said to be without fruit therefore at a time when fruit might be expected; see Mayor's elaborate note, Ep. Ju., 55-59, and reff. there): Ju 12.† (AS)

G5359.root: from Φιλάδελφος (the same as [[w:G5361]]), a king of Pergamos
G5359.strongs: Philadelphia, a place in Asia Minor

senses: a shallow bowl (= Lat. patera), used for pouring libations, etc.: [[r:REV.5.8|Rev 5:8 15:7 16:1-17 17:1 21:9]].† (AS)
φαρμακός, -ή, -όν devoted to magical arts. As subst., ὁ φ. = φαρμακεύς, a magician, sorcerer: [[r:REV.21.8|Rev 21:8 22:15]].† (AS)
